name: Magic Duel Arena
description: This arena was built for wizards to demonstrate their might in a safe environment. It is a vast, oval-shaped arena protected with a dozen magic barriers. Initially, it was used for wizards to duel but was later adapted to host group fights for sport and training. After some time, new styles of combat appeared, such as: • A group must defeat a magic simulacrum of one or more creatures, simulating powerful monsters. • A group gains 7 wands of wizard spells (three from 1st level, two from 2nd level, and one from 3rd and 4th levels). Each has four charges and is given before the combat starts. Non-wizards can use these wands, but they must use two charges for each use of the spell. No attacks or spells except those from these wands can be used during these trials.
